---
applyTo: "docs/**/*.md,README.md,.github/README.md,flutter-app/README.md,notify-worker/README.md,supabase/README.md"
---

Keep repository documentation honest and implementation-aligned.

- Describe implemented behavior as implemented behavior.
- Describe planned behavior as planned behavior.
- Keep wording aligned with the repository's reliability-lab framing.
- When documenting workflow or CI/CD behavior, ensure the documented contract matches the actual files in `.github\`.
- Prefer concise, operator-useful explanations over generic prose.
